subject: FinStack onboarding: console walkthrough + API deep-dive
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@finstack.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: FinStack onboarding: console walkthrough + API deep-dive

Hi Alex,

Great to meet you and the FinStack team on the demo yesterday — thanks for the thoughtful questions about quotas and private deployment options. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a two-part onboarding session next week: a 60-min Console walkthrough (basic flow, RBAC, dashboards, runbooks) followed by a 90-min API enablement/keys & sample integration deep-dive.

Proposed windows (all in PT):
- Option A: Tue 9/21, Console 10:00–11:00, API 11:15–12:45
- Option B: Thu 9/23, Console 14:00–15:00, API 15:15–16:45

Can you confirm which option works for your engineers? If neither, send two windows that fit your team and we’ll do our best to accommodate. I've attached a short prework checklist and our onboarding runbook so your team can pre-provision service accounts and whitelist Redwood IP ranges before the deep-dive.

Ben from our API squad will lead the technical portion; Marissa is looped for renewal/contract alignment if you want to confirm quota levels during the session.

Next steps: please reply with preferred option and attendee list (name + role). I’ll send calendar invites and a Zoom link.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-onboard-runbook.pdf (pdf), prework-checklist.md (text)

From: Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@finstack.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@finstack.io
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 01:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinStack onboarding: console walkthrough + API deep-dive

Hi Camila — thanks for the materials, they were helpful.

Option B on Thu 9/23 looks best for us. Tentative attendee list:
- Alex Roberts (CTO)
- Priya Shah (Backend eng lead)
- Mateo Gomez (SRE)

Two quick asks:
1) Can the API deep-dive include a short segment on token usage patterns and how Redwood's batching/cache recommendations affect cost?
2) We have a compliance blackout on 9/21–9/22 in APAC; Thu 9/23 afternoon PT works.

If you need any pre-reads for our SREs, share them and I’ll circulate.

— Alex

On Wed, Sep 15, 2026 at 00:02 Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [original message]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@finstack.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 17:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: FinStack onboarding: console walkthrough + API deep-dive

Thanks for confirming, Alex — Thu 9/23 14:00 PT is on my calendar as well. I’ll allocate 20–25 minutes of the API deep-dive to token economics (batching, KV/prefix cache examples, and a quick cost-vs-latency tradeoff demo).

Pre-reads for SREs: I attached a short snippet with cURL + Python examples to exercise streaming and batching, and a pointer to our cost-config recommendations doc (link below).

I’ll also bring a pre-made Mutual Action Plan template so we can lock cadence, success criteria, and an ownership matrix during the session.

Ben Carter
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: api-examples.zip (code snippets), cost-config-shortlink.txt
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-runbook

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@finstack.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: FinStack onboarding: console walkthrough + API deep-dive

Perfect — confirmed for Thu, 23 Sep (Console 14:00–15:00 PT / API 15:15–16:45 PT). Calendar invites and the Zoom link are attached below.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-id
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-runbook

Preflight checklist (quick):
- Service account + API key created by FinStack SREs (please grant "integration" role)
- Whitelist Redwood IPs (list in runbook)
- Provide a short Postman collection or curl example if you want us to run an end-to-end sample during the lab

If anything changes on your side, reply-all and we’ll re-run the scheduling flow. Looking forward to the session — I’ve blocked an opening for Marissa as well so she can take notes on commercial items.

Best,

Camila

Attachments included in invite: redwood-onboard-runbook.pdf, prework-checklist.md
